notes: Deterministic analysis slice on the 2022 update workbook (heiDATA doi:10.11588/DATA/T3MIB0/FIDTR9, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, read-only comparison reference; derived 2x2 inputs are local staging, never redistributed). Unit = study-level (189 studies with complete 2x2; the workbook's 194 included studies include 5 without complete 2x2 - recorded). Model: mada bivariate (Reitsma) pooled sensitivity/specificity, matching the published overall pooled estimates (72.0% [69.8-74.2] / 98.9% [98.6-99.1], research/ag-rdt-2022-pooled-estimates.json). Tolerances precommitted: ±2.0 pp for both, covering unit granularity and model-family differences. Exclusion rule (amended pre-run, mada model constraint): studies with >=3 zero cells dropped (f104, f189) -> 187 studies. Exclusion rule (amended pre-run, mada model constraints): >=3 zero cells OR undefined rates dropped (f104, f118, f189, f193) -> 185 studies.
